transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora. I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora, yes, I do have a few questions. First, I'm wondering when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a great question! You can start doing light gardening after 1 week following your surgery. However, I'd recommend avoiding any strenuous or heavy exercise for a full month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your surgery, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you don't have any left, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. I've been very sensitive to bright light since the surgery. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Yes, some sensitivity to bright light is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. It should settle down over time.

If it's mild, I'd recommend just wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, please let your care team know.

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Yes, some sensitivity to bright light is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. It should settle down over time.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common to have some blurriness in the first week after surgery, and this should improve quickly and settle down over time.

However, I don't know exactly how long it's been since your operation. If your vision is still quite blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for your help, Dora!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in the turn starting "Yes, some sensitivity to bright light is quite normal..." However, the agent was interrupted and did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice` in that turn or any subsequent turn.
